seo.description: Sample project: monthly acreage upkeep in Deep Cove, North Saanich: field mowing, hedge trimming and blackberry control on one schedule. Get a free quote.

summary: Monthly upkeep of lawns, long grass, hedges and beds on a two-acre lot.
scope: Blackberry control along the fence line
story: The owners travel for part of the year and wanted the property kept up while they were away.
We set monthly visits with extra spring mowing, kept blackberry off the fence line and sent photos after each visit.
Read more about [grounds maintenance](/services/grounds-maintenance/), see our work in [North Saanich](/areas/north-saanich/), or [get a free quote](/free-quote/).
result: A property kept to a set standard while the owners were away.
